introduction: You do not speak to a banker the way you speak to a child; our tone adapts to the situation.
The goal is a uniform, clear and professional experience, suited to a large-account B2B context.

principles: Accessible but not familiar (no informal address)
No emojis, no “fun” tone, no puns, avoid humour
we_use: the formal “you” (in the French copy: “vous”, never “tu”)

en: Follow the steps below
Defines the access rules
This action causes an interruption
This action is irreversible

fr: Nous allons vous guider pas à pas
Cette option vous permet de gérer facilement vos accès
Cette action peut entraîner des impacts
en: We will guide you step by step
This option makes managing your access easy
This action may cause impacts
Careful, this action is irreversible

principles: Consistent vocabulary between the console, the documentation and the internal teams
Acronyms when they are industry standards, no jargon. In the public documentation, spell the acronym out.
Careful: AK/SK is not a standard. “sponsor” means “commanditaire” (regulatory jargon is best avoided).

fr: La création d’un projet nécessite les informations suivantes : nom, description et clé d’accès.
La mise à jour nécessite un redémarrage de l’application.
en: Configuration failed
Creating a project requires the following information: name, description and access key.
The update requires an application restart.
Action required

fr: Vous devez entrer votre nom, votre description et votre clé d’accès pour créer un projet.
en: The operation could not be completed
You must enter your name, your description and your access key to create a project.
You will have to restart the application.
What would you like to do?

principles: Dynamic but controlled style. Not austere. No embellishment, stay factual and action-oriented.
Positive and direct feedback (e.g. “Action confirmed” rather than “Congratulations…”)

en: Action validated
Cluster is being created
Configuration saved
Editable settings

fr: Félicitations ! Votre action a été exécutée avec succès 🎉
Votre cluster est en train d'être créé, merci de patienter
Les modifications ont été enregistrées avec succès
N’hésitez pas à modifier ces paramètres
en: Congratulations! Your action was executed successfully 🎉
Your cluster is being created, please wait
The changes have been saved successfully
Feel free to change these settings

anglicisms_and_acronyms: Anglicisms and acronyms are accepted once they have become industry standards (e.g. VM, VPC, Public IP). CAREFUL: in the public documentation, remember to give the French translations.
Vendor-specific or ambiguous terms must be avoided (e.g. “sponsor”).
Spelling and agreement of anglicisms follow the same rules as for French words
